name: Scholomance Heroic hits like the other Heroic dungeons (#10415)
contract: #10415: Scholomance Heroic was about as hard as Mythic: its Heroic templates had a median DamageModifier of 13.19 for elites and 32.95 for bosses, against 4.27-4.69 and 14.5-18.9 in every other vanilla dungeon (Mythic elites in BRD, Stratholme, DM, Maraudon and Blackrock Spire: 10.7-13.7). Ascension's Mythic+ logs show the Scholomance bosses hitting like other dungeons' bosses (1276 against 1100-1250 median), and the ratios inside Scholomance match. The Heroic elites are scaled by 4.37 / 13.19 and the bosses by 17.56 / 32.95, which keeps those ratios; Doctor Theolen Krastinov (57.42, higher than his Mythic 12.6) gets 17.56 and the health of Lord Alexei Barov and The Ravenian (465,462 Heroic, 605,100 Mythic instead of 581,670 / 756,171; tester decision). Normal and Mythic are unchanged.
